definitions.gloss: remarks column; notes section; comments field
definitions.explanation: A designated space on a form, document, or application for writing additional notes, comments, or supplementary information.

examples.japanese: {備考欄|びこうらん}に{記入|きにゅう}してください。
examples.english: Please fill in the remarks column.

examples.japanese: アレルギーがある{方|かた}は{備考欄|びこうらん}にお{書|か}きください。
examples.english: If you have any allergies, please write them in the notes section.

examples.japanese: {備考欄|びこうらん}に{特記|とっき}すべきことがなければ、{空欄|くうらん}のままで{結構|けっこう}です。
examples.english: If there is nothing special to note in the remarks column, you may leave it blank.

notes:
FORMS:
{備考|びこう} (remarks, notes) + {欄|らん} (column, field). The {欄|らん} suffix is used for various sections of forms and documents.

USAGE:
Very common on Japanese forms of all kinds — application forms, medical forms, order forms, surveys, and official documents. Knowing this word is essential for navigating Japanese bureaucracy and paperwork.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {備考欄|びこうらん}に{記入|きにゅう}する (to fill in the remarks section)
- {備考欄|びこうらん}に{書|か}く (to write in the notes column)
- {備考欄|びこうらん}は{空欄|くうらん}でよい (the remarks column can be left blank)

RELATED WORDS:
- {備考|びこう}: remarks, notes — the content itself, without the 'column' part
- {欄|らん}: column, field — used in many compounds like {解答欄|かいとうらん} (answer section) and {記入欄|きにゅうらん} (entry field)
